capabilities: Embed local .ggb files inline via wiki embeds with size and caption syntax
Insert .ggb code blocks with configurable width, height, toolbar, algebra view, and style bar
Drag or paste .ggb files to save them to an attachment folder and insert an embed
Open .ggb files from the file list in a dedicated fullscreen interactive view
Reset and save constructions back to the original .ggb file in the vault
extras: Desktop only (uses an Electron webview; no mobile interactive embeds). The GeoGebra engine JS/CSS loads from the geogebra.org CDN, so network access is required at load time, though .ggb data stays local. Plugin folder must be named 'geogebra' or Obsidian will not load it. Installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian cannot display or interact with GeoGebra constructions inside notes unless the file is uploaded to GeoGebra.org first.
summary: GeoGebra embedder that renders interactive local .ggb constructions inline in notes via wiki embeds and code blocks, with reset and save back to the vault.
